title: déjà rêvé

additional: i like my harrykim a little codependent. just a little
kind of soulmatey if you think about it

summary:
Yet, nothing happens, aside from Kim turning his gaze to treetops lined behind Harry and the way the sun beams down on them. Harry is too absorbed in the anticlimax to notice his eyes are nervous.
“Spring is coming,” Kim only speaks, “Do you feel it?”
Vignettes of a new sunrise. Study of how light comes in, emanating between two people.
Déjà rêvé (from French, meaning "already dreamed") - the feeling of having already dreamed something that is currently being experienced.
bookmark_notes: “ What has occured to Harry many times before, that his partner had been placed on his path by some Innocence, that there is a special sort of light his lungs emanate, that he isn’t a creature made of the same particles as his own lump of skin and bones. All this is proven false in an instant. For never has he felt Kim’s humanity as much as he does now, when he feels the flesh of his lips encapsulate his own, hands on his jaw, their chests flush together. He doesn’t remember the act of kissing, but now that it’s happening, it’s almost as if they fall together naturally, as if they were always meant to do this, as if maybe they can fuse together, eventually.”
